sources.title: Connected Nations 2025
facts: Published 19 November 2025 as Ofcom's annual UK connectivity infrastructure report.
The publication reports aggregate network availability and does not by itself establish current service at an individual parcel.

sources.title: Connected Nations UK Report 2025
facts: The report is based on provider data and operator predictions with a July 2025 reference period.
National or local aggregate coverage is not promoted to an exact UPRN or orderable-service claim.

sources.title: Connected Nations 2025 Methodology Annex
sources.lines: PDF cover and methodology sections; screenshot page 1
facts: The annex documents the methods and definitions used for Connected Nations 2025.
Methodology evidence is a lineage source and not direct parcel-level service evidence.

sources.title: Connected Nations Interactive Report 2025
facts: The interactive report provides area-level exploration of Connected Nations data.
Displayed values remain subject to Ofcom's source methodology and reference date.

sources.title: Nations Report 2025
facts: Ofcom published separate 2025 connectivity summaries for England, Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland.
Nation statistics are not treated as current orderable service for a property.

sources.title: Connected Nations Data Downloads 2025
facts: The page publishes data supporting Connected Nations 2025 and year-on-year comparisons.
A downloadable record is not promoted beyond its published spatial resolution.

sources.title: Connected Nations FAQs
facts: The FAQ explains interpretation of Connected Nations coverage and availability reporting.
FAQ guidance cannot independently establish a parcel-level connection.

sources.title: Connected Nations Update: Spring 2026
sources.lines: publication summary and January 2026 reference date
facts: The spring update is a January 2026 snapshot of fixed and mobile availability.
Snapshot coverage remains aggregate and cannot be interpreted as an orderability check.

sources.title: Connected Nations Planned Network Deployment
facts: The PND series reports operators' stated plans for very high-capacity fixed networks.
Planned coverage is never treated as existing or orderable service.

sources.title: Connected Nations Planned Network Deployments 2026
facts: The report uses operators' stated plans as of January 2026 through January 2029.
Forecast values are retained as plans and never promoted to current parcel truth.

sources.title: Building Digital UK Performance Information
facts: The collection separates official statistics, monthly contract reporting and annual accounts.
Publication class and reporting basis are preserved for every candidate.

sources.title: Premises Contracted and Built, Project Gigabit Contracts
facts: BDUK publishes monthly contract-level contracted and built premises reports.
Monthly snapshots are interpreted with their data-lag and scope limitations.

sources.title: October 2025: Premises Contracted and Built under Project Gigabit Contracts
sources.lines: overview, scope, lag and rounded contract table
facts: The October 2025 publication is a dated contract-level management-information snapshot.
The report warns against using the figures to assess milestones or current parcel orderability.
